polish_presence.summary: SMP Poland, part of US-based Standard Motor Products, designs and produces automotive coils, sensors and switches in Białystok and employs between 501 and 1,000 people.

sources.title: AmCham Poland (American Chamber of Commerce in Poland) member list

notes: Only a range (501-1,000) is published; a pracuj.pl profile reportedly says 850+. Email domain smpcorp.com assumed.

name: Corning Optical Communications Polska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: optical fibre and cable manufacturing

polish_presence.summary: Corning runs two plants in Stryków near Łódź and an optical-fibre plant in Mszczonów; in April 2026 it announced a third Stryków plant, an investment it says will help create about 2,500 jobs.

sources.title: AmCham Poland (American Chamber of Commerce in Poland) member list

notes: 2,500 refers to jobs linked to the new investment, not current headcount; a pracuj.pl profile reportedly says "several thousand" across Stryków and Mszczonów (not verified). corning.com answers 403 to scripted requests. Mszczonów plant from a 2022 Corning release (search result).

name: UPS Global Business Services Polska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: logistics company global business services centres (finance, HR, IT, customer service)

polish_presence.summary: UPS Global Business Services Polska has offices in Wrocław (centre founded 2006), Łódź and Warsaw, where it employs more than 1,400 qualified staff.

relationship_note: Shared services centres in Wrocław, Łódź and Warsaw; UPS Polska (courier operations) is a separate company.

sources.title: AmCham Poland (American Chamber of Commerce in Poland) member list
ABSL (Association of Business Service Leaders) member directory
Eurobuild CEE - UPS opens a second global shared services centre in Łódź

name: CEVA Logistics Poland Sp. z o.o.
subsector: contract logistics, warehousing and freight management

polish_presence.summary: CEVA Logistics' contract-logistics team in Poland took over a new 40,000 m² automated e-commerce warehouse in Magnice near Wrocław (2022), recruiting and training staff for 24/7 operations; it also runs warehouses near Warsaw, Gliwice and Gdynia.

sources.title: CCIFP (French-Polish Chamber of Commerce) member catalogue

notes: No Polish headcount found; press said about 1,000 people were being recruited for the Magnice site alone (2022). Other warehouse locations from pracuj.pl listings seen via search (not re-checked). cevalogistics.com answers 403 to scripted requests.

name: ID Logistics Polska S.A.
subsector: contract logistics and e-commerce fulfilment

polish_presence.summary: ID Logistics (head office in Katowice) operates contract-logistics centres in Poland and in 2021 prepared four new automated e-commerce warehouses.

sources.title: CCIFP (French-Polish Chamber of Commerce) member catalogue (page 17)

notes: No verified headcount: job postings seen via search cite 6,000-7,000 employees and 18 logistics centres in Poland (not re-checked). id-logistics.com drops scripted connections.

name: Hays Poland Sp. z o.o.
subsector: specialist recruitment and staffing

polish_presence.summary: Hays opened its first Polish office in 2003 and employs 400 people in offices in Warsaw, Katowice, Wrocław, Kraków, Tri-City and Poznań.

sources.title: AmCham Poland (American Chamber of Commerce in Poland) member list
ABSL (Association of Business Service Leaders) member directory

name: Abbott Laboratories Poland Sp. z o.o.
subsector: medical devices, diagnostics and nutrition

polish_presence.summary: Abbott's Polish branch, headquartered in Warsaw for over 20 years, has more than 200 employees working in diagnostics, cardiovascular, diabetes care and neuromodulation.

sources.title: AmCham Poland (American Chamber of Commerce in Poland) member list

notes: Two Polish entities appear on the site (Abbott Laboratories and Abbott Medical tax strategies); the 200+ figure is the company's statement for its Polish branch.

name: SGS Polska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: testing, inspection and certification

polish_presence.summary: SGS Polska employs 650 full-time staff; its head office is in Warsaw and it has about 30 offices and laboratories across Poland.

name: Schiever Polska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: hypermarkets (bi1 brand and Auchan franchise stores) and shopping galleries

polish_presence.summary: Schiever Polska, part of the French Schiever group, runs hypermarkets in Poland under its own bi1 brand (8 stores) and Auchan-branded stores, plus shopping galleries.

sources.title: CCIFP (French-Polish Chamber of Commerce) member catalogue (page 28)

notes: No headcount found; kept because a chain of hypermarkets plainly employs well over 100 people (not quantified). Separate employer from Auchan Polska (Auchan is already in the known list). Poznań head office from the CCIFP directory.

name: Stock Polska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: spirits production (Żołądkowa Gorzka, Lubelska)

polish_presence.summary: Stock Polska is part of Stock Spirits Group, which has 7 production plants including 2 in Poland and over 1,800 employees; its flagship brand is Żołądkowa Gorzka.

sources.title: AmCham Poland (American Chamber of Commerce in Poland) member list

notes: Polish headcount not found; two Polish plants (Lublin is the known site, not stated on the page). Group HQ country set to GB (not verified after the 2021 ownership change). Email domain assumed.

name: MAHLE Polska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: automotive engine components and thermal management; R&D, logistics and shared services

polish_presence.summary: MAHLE has produced in Krotoszyn since 1999 (cylinder liners, pistons, valves, filters, camshafts) and the site currently has about 3,500 employees; MAHLE also runs an R&D centre, a logistics centre and a shared services centre in Poland.

sources.title: ABSL (Association of Business Service Leaders) member directory

notes: Headcount covers the Krotoszyn site only. Ostrów Wielkopolski, Psary and Wrocław locations come from employer profiles seen via search (not re-checked).

name: UPM in Poland (UPM Raflatac plants and UPM Business Hub Wrocław)
subsector: self-adhesive label materials manufacturing and business services hub

polish_presence.summary: UPM employed about 1,000 people in Poland in 2021: 230 at the Business HUB Wrocław and about 700 at the UPM Raflatac factories near Wrocław (Biskupice Podgórne and Nowa Wieś Wrocławska).

sources.title: ABSL (Association of Business Service Leaders) member directory

notes: Headcount dated January 2021 (City of Wrocław article).

name: Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Sp. z o.o.
subsector: electrical connection and industrial automation components manufacturing

polish_presence.summary: Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska in Nowy Tomyśl, founded in 1994, is the third-largest production site of the Phoenix Contact Group, with around 2,500 employees (2019).

sources.title: ABSL (Association of Business Service Leaders) member directory

notes: Headcount dated October 2019 (company blog). A separate Polish sales company and a newer e-mobility plant near Rzeszów exist (search results, not verified).

name: SKF Polska S.A.
subsector: bearings manufacturing

polish_presence.summary: SKF runs a bearing factory in Poznań (the former state bearing works it took over in the 1990s); in 2023 it decided to move spherical roller bearing production from its Luton plant to Poznań.

sources.title: ABSL (Association of Business Service Leaders) member directory

notes: No Polish headcount found; kept as a large manufacturing site. Legal form (S.A. vs Sp. z o.o.) not verified. skf.com returns an empty page to scripted requests (HTTP 200).
